svg.title: Tuition payment | Durable intent and atomic settlement

g.text: Tuition payment | Durable intent and atomic settlement
[UI polls 1.5 s while pending; worker polls every 3 s]
Return stored state; no duplicate posting
Callback body is only a reference hint; provider status is authoritative.
Current gateway blocks unauthenticated callback ingress.
Poller queries status; it does not resubmit a lost MTN request.
Provider call is inside the reconciliation lock lifetime.
